facts.fact: The Office of the Prime Minister's own IT Sub-Division states its core functions include developing systems, implementing and maintaining systems, systems administration, networking and maintaining ICT equipment for the Office; the document has no stated date, so its 2022 published year is used.
facts.system: Office of the Prime Minister ICT systems and network

facts.fact: The OPM IT Sub-Division lists other offices, ministries and agencies (OMAs), state-owned enterprises, the Auditor General and regional councils and local authorities as external clients of its ICT services; the document has no stated date, so its 2022 published year is used.
facts.system: Office of the Prime Minister IT Sub-Division services

systems.system: Office of the Prime Minister ICT systems and network
